technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but severely undermined by bearish price structure, weak trend confirmation, and negative volume/momentum indicators—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: FCX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 86 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only small-amount sales and no recent buys; lack of news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (421.6), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational FCX, and earnings in 86 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 oversold with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend confirmation offer mean-reversion bounce potential, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (23/100) creating contrarian opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), pervasive bearish price structure (below all key moving averages, below Ichimoku cloud), negative volume/momentum (CMF, OBV, MACD), zero fundamental conviction, and imminent earnings event (86 days) create unacceptable risk-reward for weak technical confluence.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI oversold with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend support offer tactical bounce potential in extreme fear environment. However, severe macro headwinds, pervasive bearish price structure, and zero fundamental conviction make risk-reward unacceptable for portfolio entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (421.6), flat yield curve recession signal, and imminent earnings event (86 days) create compounding macro and event risk that overshadows mean-reversion bounce setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 3 positions in Materials sector; adding FCX increases concentration risk without offsetting fundamental or smart-money conviction to justify sector overweight.
